lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular pixel clusters organized into at least five distinct horizontal rows posterior to the gill region, with spacing increasing toward the ventral-posterior axis.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated luminance intersecting the horizontal spot rows to create a structured grid-like pattern across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent longitudinal ridge is visible running from the dorsal area toward the caudal peduncle, defined by a sharp light-to-shadow gradient along its horizontal axis.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-density distribution of small, high-luminance blobs visible on the lateral surface of the first dorsal fin, appearing more scattered than the flank pattern.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinct irregular notch and missing tissue segment on the posterior-superior margin of the upper caudal fin lobe.
